description: This file defines constants, enums, structs, and function prototypes for device presence detection, including ARP handling, IP address management, and device state tracking in a network environment.

classes.name: arp_hdr
classes.description: Struct representing an ARP header with hardware type, protocol type, operation code, and MAC/IP addresses.

classes.name: DnsmasqEventQData
classes.description: Struct for DNSMasq event queue data including IP, enable flag, MAC, and message type.

classes.name: PresenceQData
classes.description: Struct for presence message data including message content and message type.

classes.name: LmPresenceDeviceInfo
classes.description: Struct representing device information such as MAC, IPv4, IPv6 addresses, activity status, detection states, and retry counts.

classes.name: LmDevicePresenceDetectionInfo
classes.description: Struct for managing device presence detection configuration, callback, device list, detection intervals, retries, and task state.

methods.name: allocate_ustrmem
methods.description: Allocates memory for unsigned string buffers.

methods.name: getipaddressfromarp
methods.description: Extracts IP address from ARP line input.

methods.name: PresenceDetection_AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to presence detection list.

methods.name: PresenceDetection_RemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from presence detection list.

methods.name: Presencedetection_DmlNotifyMac
methods.description: Notifies MAC address addition or removal.

methods.name: getConfiguredMaclistStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status of configured MAC list.

methods.name: resetPresenceDetectionList
methods.description: Resets the presence detection list for a given MAC.
